features.envelope_definition: Subjective baseline localization envelope in encoded pixels; not a calibrated uncertainty or confidence interval.
features.role_limit: Apparent neighboring-building roof-edge patch, not WTC7. Exact building, component, material point and depth are unauthenticated. The brightness may include a highlight; blur, compression, repeated rooftop texture, background inclusion and differing-depth overlap may alter apparent position or matching. Physical stationarity is an assumption, not a result.
features.selection_basis: Direct baseline appearance and explicit coordinate-marker correspondence only; no later-frame performance or new numerical gate result used.
features.visual_association: The proposed center falls within the visible bright patch in the native baseline crop; a separately labeled 5x nearest-neighbor crop brackets that exact source pixel without covering it. It is not the old dark-area coordinate (288,400).
